First, we isolate the absolute value on the left side of the equation:

 

$$
\begin{aligned}2|2a-4|-7 & =13 \\ 2|2a-4| & =20 \\ |2a-4| & =10\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we have the following two cases:

- If $|2a-4| = 2a-4,$ we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}|2a-4| & =10 \\ 2a-4 & =10 \\ 2a & =14 \\ a & =7\end{aligned}
$$

- If $|2a-4| = -(2a-4),$ we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}|2a-4| & =10 \\ -(2a-4) & =10 \\ -2a+4 & =10 \\ -2a & =6 \\ a & =-3\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solutions are $a=-3$ and $a=7.$
